C. briggsae Isolated by Michael Ailion from rotting apricot from home of Wayne Davis and Danielle Endres in Salt Lake City, Utah, 8/4/2006, under tree on north side of house. Coordinates: 40 42' 26.16"""" N, 111 52' 3.27"""" W. Animals move very rapidly. Strain started from a single L4 hermaphrodite and grown three generations before freezing. 18S rDNA sequence differs from C. briggsae NCBI entry (PB102), but is identical to the 18S sequence of AF16, HK104, PB800 and VT847. Cross-fertile with AF16.

new hermaphroditic Caenorhabditis species (see EG4181). this ""strain"" consists of a mix of the worms that came from the apricot to try to maintain as much diversity as possible in the population and thus is not a true strain in the traditional sense. it will be submitted as contaminated worms since it cannot be cleaned up without going through a bottleneck.
C. briggsae wild isolate from rotten plum collected by Stori Jensen 10/17/07 in Cottonwood Heights area (40.6, -111.8), Salt Lake City, UT. 18S rDNA sequence identical to briggsae. Mates with AF16.

C. briggsae wild isolate from rotten acorn collected by Linda Hauth 10/21/07 at the Shoreline Trail near Red Butte Garden, Salt Lake City, UT (~ 40.7667 N, -111.82655 W). 18S rDNA sequence identical to C. briggsae. Mates with AF16.

wild isolate from rotten jack fruit collected 4/29/09 by Michael Ailion from near Dois Rios, Ilha Grande, Brazil (-23.18234;-44.19456). many animals of various stages emerged from the fruit, but strain was started from a single L4. the rotten samples that gave strains EG5612-EG5614 all were in the same bag during transport from Brazil, so there is a possibility that these strains are not independent and all came from the same fruit.

EG5613 appears to border more than EG5612 or EG5614.

This strain was started from a single L4. It looks like briggsae. Designated as briggsae because it produced healthy F1 males when hermaphrodites were mated to AF16 males.

Designated as briggsae because it produced healthy F1 males when hermaphrodites were mated to AF16 males.
